svg.text: A4 – Local vs Cloud vs Hybrid — console output capture

g.text: 1 Tiny on-device image classification: ON-DEVICE FEASIBLE
2 Cloud speech recognition: NETWORK-BOUND (hybrid for latency)
5 Real-time multiplayer state sync: HYBRID REQUIRED
6 Offline vector tile rendering: BATTERY-CRITICAL (on-device feasible with caching)
Performance needs a measurable bottleneck, workload, device and target (frame time, joules, p95 latency).
